# backend/requirements.txt -- installed by Render with: pip install -r requirements.txt
#
# Every version below is EXACT (==) and copied from the fastapi-env virtual
# environment the app was tested in (Python 3.12.10), so Render installs the
# same thing that ran on the developer's PC. Loose ">=" pins let Render pick
# newer versions than the ones tested; that already broke a deploy once
# (an unpickled model needs matching scikit-learn/xgboost versions).
#
# To change a version: upgrade it in the venv, re-run the test scripts in
# scripts/, then update the line here. Do not edit versions blindly.

# --- web framework -----------------------------------------------------------
fastapi==0.141.1
starlette==1.6.0
pydantic==2.13.5
uvicorn==0.52.4
python-multipart==0.0.32

# --- data + machine learning (must match the versions the model was built with) ---
numpy==2.5.2
pandas==3.0.5
scipy==1.18.1
scikit-learn==1.9.0
# xgboost-cpu is the same xgboost 3.4.1 (same 'import xgboost', same model format)
# without the ~250 MB NVIDIA GPU libraries that the plain 'xgboost' package pulls
# in on Linux. Render's free instance has no GPU and limited disk, so use the CPU
# build there. (Your PC's venv keeps plain xgboost 3.4.1; do not install both.)
xgboost-cpu==3.4.1
joblib==1.6.0

# --- database (SQLite locally, Neon Postgres on Render via DATABASE_URL) ----------
SQLAlchemy==2.0.51
psycopg2-binary==2.9.13

# --- PDF reports -------------------------------------------------------------------
reportlab==5.0.1
pillow==12.3.0
